newsitem.title: DUBAI: Slow year-end trade leaves UAE stocks flat.
newsitem.headline: Slow year-end trade leaves UAE stocks flat.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates stock market ended the week to Thursday mostly steady in quiet trade as investors waited for year-end results of traded companies and banks, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index crept up 5.61 points to 2,467.41 from 2,461.80.
Brokers said trade was limited because banks and companies were closing their 1996 books and investors were waiting for end of year financial results to help determine market direction.
Nine stocks rose, two fell and the rest were steady.

Al-Khazna Insurance extended its recent fall, ending at 295 from 310 dirhams week earlier. Dubai Investment Co was steady at 13.5 dirhams and market leader telecommunications company Etisalat was unchanged at 955 for the sixth week running.
The Oman and Emirates Investment Co ticked up another 50 fils to end the week at 10 dirhams.
The Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co rose 10 dirhams to 1,040 while the Emirates Insurance Co gathered five dirhams to 615.
Among banking stocks, the Abu Dhabi National Bank continued to climb, gaining five dirhams to close at 435. The Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank rose to 330 from 328 a week earlier.
